shared_rules: Own only assigned paths; do not alter canonical curriculum, shared sources/status/build/verify/hosting or other assignments. No child agents, deployments or installs. Root alone reviews, integrates and publishes.

Original undergraduate cumulative assessments; all methods must already be taught in accepted v08 chapters and prerequisites. Explicit units, dates, claim perimeter, taxes, contract rights, risk/pricing assumptions and limits. No real market/tax/legal claim from fictional inputs.

Exams are closed-book with nonprogrammable calculator, 240 minutes; each has five questions, each exactly four five-point subparts (100 points). Use IDs v08-a-q1a through v08-a-q5d or b equivalents on data-points=5 elements. Each complete worked answer maps once using data-solution-for. Provide explicit five-point analytic credit allocations and error-carry-forward rules. Domain scores Q1–Q5 each20; no domain below15/20 and total at least85, plus transfer/teach-back. Do not disclose solutions in prompts.

Exam fragments need h2 id=form-a/form-b, full original prompts then details class=solutions containing h2 id=solutions-a/solutions-b. Unique prefixed case anchors. Every chapter must map to a substantive assessed subpart; keep exact coverage mapping in review JSON.

Reuse scoped verified source methods and link accepted chapter routes; any sources proposed as JSON list of exact existing source records, or new fully inspected primary records. Problems/code/data entirely original. Do not browse redundantly for stable already-verified methods; browse if relying on uncertain or current fact.

Each assignment supplies a standard-library focused numerical checker with quiet check() returning strict JSON, independent reconstructions and meaningful economic-domain checks; no implementation-mirroring assertions alone. Complete prompt/solution review, numerical anchors, all final owned payload SHA256/byte sizes, no open material findings in author record. Checks are not external human certification or UI QA.

Public project asset hrefs use flat published filenames, not projects/ prefixes. Coordinate assumptions and numerical anchors early; preserve readable spacing. Do not accept your own package; coordinator independently audits it.
